properties.name: easyai.web.project-selection-enabled
properties.description: Whether the console offers project selection. When false the UI hides the project picker and every chat runs in a per-session temporary workspace; the API still accepts an explicit projectId.

properties.name: easyai.web.console.enabled
properties.description: Whether immutable caching applies to the console bundle's hashed /assets/** tree. Response compression is configured independently through server.compression.*. Set false in a backend that serves no console.
